scalars.scalar_value: Experience supervising and evaluating staff in a small animal hospital, veterinary specialty or emergency service setting.

items.item_text: Current California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) Licensure.
Experience supervising and evaluating staff in a small animal hospital, veterinary specialty or emergency service setting.
Experience writing and conducting performance evaluations.

Experience communicating orally and in writing with a diverse group of people including clients, clinicians, referring veterinarians, students, and staff in an accurate, professional and collegial manner.

Experience working independently or as part of a team to coordinate, facilitate, set up equipment and supplies, troubleshoot and anticipate needs for activities in assigned areas in an accurate, efficient and timely manner.
5 years' experience working in specialty or ER.

Independent of supervision of the Hospital Manager and Executive Director, provide supervision of technical staff. Assess service needs including daily receiving and procedure schedules, staffing levels, work schedules and equipment. Assess and provide staff training needs, develop, manage and update training protocols and documentation. Responsible for direct supervision of skilled employees including probationary and annual reviews, counseling and disciplinary action, managing appropriate staffing levels, and evaluating clinical competency. Provide para-veterinary technical, anesthesia and nursing support for a variety of invasive, non-invasive and diagnostic procedures. Provide instruction to staff, students, and clinicians in proper techniques for restraint and handling of patients, nursing care, administering treatments and obtaining a variety of diagnostic samples.
Skills recognizing, assessing and providing staff mentoring in conflict resolution and specific service protocols.
Advanced skills in patient care with ability to monitor critically ill patients.
